name: MOMENT
summary: MOMENT is a proposed Chinese facility using low-energy neutrinos from muon decay to investigate leptonic CP violation. It remains a facility and sensitivity study in the cited literature.
physics_targets: Leptonic CP violation and neutrino oscillations
detection_principle: A multi-megawatt proton linac would create pions in a high-field target station. Pions decay into muons, and a transport and decay channel supplies electron- and muon-flavour neutrinos and antineutrinos. A distant detector would compare flavour transitions for different source polarities.
technologies: Candidate gadolinium-loaded water Cherenkov or scintillator detector

sites.name: Proposed Chinese source and medium-baseline detector
sites.location: Candidate implementation; no final construction site established

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The facility paper and 2022 physics overview describe a proposal and projected sensitivity. They do not establish construction or operation.

results.summary: Studied projected oscillation and new-physics sensitivity for assumed detector performance and exposure. No MOMENT neutrino data are reported.
